runtime/random_distribution#

The native layer under random/distribution: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under random/distribution: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

Portable finite-float primitives used by random/distribution algorithms.
